subject.title: feat: let agents remember across private conversations

question: Should OpenClaw accept `memorySearch.rememberAcrossConversations` and the runtime-only `conversationRecall` plugin context as supported public contracts after the doctor-path defect is corrected?
rationale: The implementation is a new user-facing memory mode with a compatibility-sensitive config key and a security-sensitive authorization seam; source review cannot choose whether that permanent product surface is desired.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded recall mode
options.body: Approve the default-off same-agent-private contract after the CodeQL defect is fixed and the privacy/upgrade guarantees are accepted.

options.title: Narrow or defer the surface
options.body: Keep the canonical feature request open and require a smaller experimental or plugin-only direction if maintainers do not want to own this config and context API yet.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded recall mode
recommendation.body: Approve the default-off same-agent-private contract after the CodeQL defect is fixed and the privacy/upgrade guarantees are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR, co-authored the current head, and documented the revised provider-routing and fail-closed boundary decisions.
